title: Phase 2 mobility reconciliation boundary
summary: Stop, platform, station, locality, route, trip and service day are distinct. Keys are authority/feed/version scoped; NaPTAN ATCO, NaptanCode, NPTG, ORR NLC/TLC, GTFS stop_id and WIGOS must never be equated by spelling. Schedules describe supply, annual rail usage is an estimate, and geography/weather associations do not establish station identity.
